evidence.locator: Choosing Google Authentication; method sections; GitHub Authentication
evidence.finding: Documents Gemini API keys, Vertex keys, Google Cloud WIF and Code Assist/Vertex routes; GitHub identity separately uses repository token or a custom GitHub App.

evidence.locator: on; dispatch if gate; selected workflow jobs
evidence.finding: The source workflow handles issue/PR/review/comment events, checks trusted commenter association and dispatches to specialized workflows.

evidence.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/issue-triage/gemini-scheduled-triage.yml
evidence.locator: on.schedule cron; concurrency group/cancel-in-progress; triage runs-on and timeout

evidence.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/gemini-assistant/README.md
evidence.locator: Core features; Interaction Flow; exact plan-comment approval
evidence.finding: Code changes use an exact bot-authored plan approval comment and verified plan artifact, after which the assistant may branch, commit and open a PR.

evidence.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/pr-review/README.md
evidence.finding: The PR workflow uses Gemini CLI code-review extension and returns a structured review summary and inline GitHub comments.

evidence.title: run-gemini-cli docs/observability.md
